FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE
For the financial year ended 31 December 2025 ("FY 2025"), IREIT and its subsidiaries reported
gross revenue of €50.4 million, representing a 33.3% decrease from €75.6 million in FY 2024.
Net property income decreased by 38.7% year-on-year.
